heading: Builtin dispatch
text:
## Builtin dispatch [IRET.13]

All builtins are ours — there is no user-extension surface. A CALL
expression node (rete `CallExpr`) carries a
numeric **`BuiltinFn` op** on the wire (`proto/builtin_fn.proto`); the
runtime dispatches by that op through a global, op-indexed array — no builtin
name strings, no hashing, no interning.

The builtin signature is `ds_fn_t`, declared in `runtime/src/libds/fn.h`.
